description: Italian cadastral CLI — convert between cadastral references (provincia/comune/foglio/particella) and WGS84 GPS coordinates, online or offline. Bridges the Agenzia delle Entrate public ajax endpoint and the community ondata Parquet centroid dataset, with offline cache and agent-native JSON output.

tools.name: lookup_gps_to_cadastral
tools.description: Resolve a WGS84 longitude/latitude point to the cadastral parcel it falls inside. Returns province code, comune codice belfiore, comune name, sezione, foglio, and particella identifier. Required: op, lon, lat.

params.name: lon
params.description: Longitude in WGS84 decimal degrees (EPSG:4326). Italy roughly spans 6.6 to 18.5.

params.name: lat
params.description: Latitude in WGS84 decimal degrees (EPSG:4326). Italy roughly spans 35.5 to 47.1.
